edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely neutral — his Q-empowered autos deal real magic damage and his Crushing Blow shreds armor, so don't stand in the spirit blade path and take free trades. Farm safely with Q tip range and preserve energy. At Level 2 your W spirit zone enters the picture: hold it as a reactive block, not a preemptive zone, so it shuts off his auto burst when he steps up.
